channel.title: Paksh: Politics

item.description: The Trump administration is facilitating the temporary sale of certain unapproved peptides. Additionally, government lawyers will represent unaccompanied immigrant children. Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.description: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi arrived in Chennai to meet actor Vijay at his residence. Following the meeting, Gandhi and Vijay were seen having coffee together. Gandhi also attended an event called 'Chhatron Ki Goonj' to hear from students. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 3.
